Just my opinion. This is my opinion from someone who has faithfully read these devotionals for years. 

The devotionals are beginning to feel like they are random short stories or personal experiences where the writers talks about their children, their childhood or about a time in history which doesn’t always tie directly into the Scriptures. 

Many of the writers who have writing for the app for sometime now do a great job aligning the devotional to the Scripture. These writers produce Biblically based devotions which tie directly into the Word of God. 

Many of the newer writers share random stories which often leave me puzzled and questioning “What does this have to do with the Scripture that we are focusing on for that day?”

I don’t mind that the APP are using new writers but hopefully they will start focusing more on the Word of God rather than just sharing personal stories and attaching a bible verse to it. 

The prayers at the end are usually short and sweet, but occasionally I’ll come across a prayer that is so out of touch with the Word/Scripture or devotional itself.
